description: This file contains implementation of DNS server iterator classes for handling DNS server selection logic, including DoH and classic DNS servers, with methods for getting the next attempt index and checking server availability.

classes.name: DnsServerIterator
classes.description: Base class for DNS server iteration, managing common properties and constructor.

classes.name: DohDnsServerIterator
classes.description: Derived class implementing DNS over HTTPS (DoH) server selection logic.

classes.name: ClassicDnsServerIterator
classes.description: Derived class implementing classic DNS server selection logic.

methods.name: GetNextAttemptIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the next DNS server to attempt, considering failure counts and server availability.

methods.name: AttemptAvailable
methods.description: Checks if there is any DNS server available for attempt based on current session and attempt limits.
